lens: REPRODUCE AND DATE-SPLIT (verify-8-reproduce): re-implemented R1 from its expr with the shared loader (own code), recomputed bets/games/CLV (all closes and close_ok, game-clustered 95% CI, 4000 resamples), ROI, date halves; then hunted look-ahead, NaN drops, baseline mismatch, close-source mechanics and second-half size.
rule: R1 EV-gated window entry: buy at the first c/w (CNO-family) look inside 2-360 min of the start where the listed EV is at least 2.5%
numbers_reproduced: MATCHES THE BUILDER. Bets 184, games 44 (exact). CLV at the entry look's price, all closes: +2.5448% (0.025447580..., identical to the builder to 15 digits) on 116 closes / 40 games, 95% game-cluster CI [+1.77%, +3.52%] (builder [+1.82%, +3.53%]: bootstrap seed/n difference only), 76.7% beat the close. close_ok (drops Novig-trades closes of <3 trades): +2.669% [+1.85%, +3.72%] on 108 closes / 39 games. CLV at the FIRST-LISTED price (loader clv) for the same 116 bets: +1.639% [+0.88%, +2.65%]. ROI at the look price: -6.734% on 178 (VOID counted 0, the builder's way) [-22.8%, +11.0%], 43 games; -6.772% on the 177 WON/LOST bets; 6 bets still PENDING. per_day 184/2.256 = 81.56 (matches). Baselines: same 116 bets at their first c/w look +1.684% (matches the builder's 'baseline'); ALL 683 closed bets +0.192% [-0.35%, +0.80%] on 69 games (the +0.19% of the builder's luck text); all 571 bets with a c/w look at that first look +0.38%. DATE HALVES: the builder's first/second half (+2.429% / +2.569%) is a split by DECISION DAY Oct 3 | Oct 4-5 = 20 closes / 16 games vs 96 closes / 24 games: the 'second half' is 83% of the closes, so it is not a hold-out. With the loader's equal-games split_by_date (cut Oct 4): first half (firstDay<=Oct 4) 130 bets, 98 closes / 35 games, CLV +2.362% [+1.56%, +3.49%], ROI -6.2% (124 settled, 39 games); second half (Oct 5) 54 bets, 18 closes / 5 games, CLV +3.540% [+3.13%, +4.73%], ROI -8.1% (53 settled, 6 games [-66%, +13%]). Splitting on the entry (decision) day gives the same closes (98 / 18) with 38 / 6 games and no game shared between halves; the firstDay split shares 2 games. By decision day: Oct 3 +2.43% (20 closes, 16 games), Oct 4 +2.35% (78, 19 games), Oct 5 +3.54% (18, 5 games). The 'replicates in both game-day groups' claim is real for Tracker-measured CLV and is positive everywhere.
reason: The arithmetic reproduces exactly and I found no look-ahead (looks are time-monotone within every bet, ids 1842/1842; the decision uses only the look's own EV; no NaN in any c/w look price/EV/fair, so the >= mask drops nothing silently). But the edge that 'survives' is carried by a same-source yardstick, and against the right baseline and independent closes the evidence is thin. (1) 75 of the 116 closes (65%) are Tracker closes = CNO's own consensus re-read before the start. For them CLV is mechanically about the listed EV: mean listed EV 3.56% vs CLV +3.49% (ratio 0.98); mean (closeFair - fair at the entry look) = -0.02 pts. The +3.49% is 'CNO's fair did not move', not 'beat the market'. Against independent closes the CLV is +0.81% [-0.04%, +2.13%] on 33 closes / 23 games (one-sided bootstrap p(<=0) = 0.040, reproduces the builder), vs a listed EV of 3.26% (ratio 0.25); Novig-trades closes alone (36; 28 with >=3 trades) give +0.45% (+0.33% close_ok) against listed EV 3.14% (ratio 0.14). A p of 0.04 after ~522 variants tried is not a result; the builder's own Bonferroni used 15 families. (2) Wrong comparator for the 'timing' claim. Vigilant's auto-bet already needs >= 2.5%, so the real alternative is 'first look with EV>=2.5% at ANY time before the start' (no window): that gives +1.59% [+0.72%, +2.62%] on 196 closes / 44 games. R1 differs from it only in two ways. (a) WAITING for a requalifier (first qualifying look > 6 h out, an in-window qualifier later): 19 bets, 12 closes / 9 games, +0.25 pts [-0.51, +0.89] vs buying at the early qualifying look; 5 independent closes. The builder's '+0.86 pts from waiting' compares with the first c/w look at ANY EV (often under 2.5%, a bet nobody would place), so it is mostly the EV rising across the bar, not a decision gain; 36 of the 98 requalifiers had their first look outside the window. (b) SKIPPING bets whose first qualifying look is > 6 h out (176 bets, 80 closes / 21 games, CLV +0.25% [-2.0%, +2.0%]; 6-12 h -0.59% on 27 closes/11 games, 12-24 h +1.01% on 63/20, 24 h+ 70 bets with only 2 closes). In-window first qualifiers (104 closes) vs those: +2.46 pts [+0.65, +4.82] on all closes, but on INDEPENDENT closes only +0.49 pts [-2.05, +3.23] (28 vs 27 closes, 27 games, p(<=0)=0.29): the window effect is not visible on an independent yardstick (the >6 h qualifiers have independent CLV +0.82%, the same as R1's +0.81%). (3) Lift over R1's complement (in-window bets that never reach 2.5%): +2.19 pts [+1.45, +3.13] on all closes (reproduces) but only +0.68 pts [-0.17, +1.89] (p(<=0)=0.056, 51 games) on independent closes: 33 R1 closes (+0.81%) vs 156 (+0.13%). The EV does predict independent CLV (slope 0.40, cluster SE 0.18, 189 closes/51 games; vs 0.74 SE 0.28 on all closes), roughly half of the listed EV, intercept -0.3 pts: a ~3.5% listed EV buys about +1.1%, so the gate is directionally right, but that is what the app's 2.5% bar already does. (4) The second half is too small: 6 games (5 with closes), 18 closes, all Tracker, 32% close coverage on Oct 5 (vs 77% on Oct 3-4), ZERO independent closes (all 33 independent closes are from Oct 3-4 entries: 7 on Oct 3 +1.4%, 26 on Oct 4 +0.7%). It 'holds' but cannot refute anything: its CI [+3.1%, +4.7%] is a bootstrap over 5 games. (5) ROI -6.7% [-22.8%, +11.0%] on 43 games is uninformative (a +3% true edge needs thousands of bets). Verdict: do not rank R1 as a proven improvement. Directionally supportive on all yardsticks (every cut is positive), not distinguishable from 'EV >= 2.5% at any time' on independent closes.
caveats: Entry-time bands (decision-time, all 184 bets): 2-30 min 64 bets, CLV +3.04% (41 closes/23 games) but independent +0.66% (16/11 games, CI [+0.20%, +1.29%]); 31-120 min 43 bets +2.79% (28/16), independent +2.46% (7/6 games); 121-360 min 77 bets +1.97% (47/21), independent -0.10% (10 closes/8 games). The early part of the window (2-6 h) shows nothing on the independent yardstick; the window edge might be shorter than 6 h, but n is 10-16 per band.

35% of R1's entries (64 of 184) fall in the last 30 min before the start and the median entry is 75 min out; feasibility (listed dollars, order latency, the sharp check, trap guard) is another verifier's lens and R1's CLV assumes the look's price was takeable.

R1 is 87% props (160 of 184 bets; 98 of 116 closes): independent closes for props can only be Novig's last trades (28 of 33 independent closes; 82% props), the weakest independent yardstick (a price in the last 30 min, 3+ trades).

Population: R1 covers CNO-family (c/w) looks only; 238 of 2080 bets were seen only by Vigilant's own scan (v) and cannot be in R1. 45 of R1's 184 entries (24%) are wide-read looks the app's CNO list did not carry at that moment (hidden by BOOKS 17, ODDS 16, EV 6 ...), of which only 8 have a close; the app would have to read the wide list to take them. c and w EVs agree at the same minute on 91.7% of 5361 paired looks (mean 1.98% vs 1.95%), so no systematic w-vs-c EV bias.

Close coverage is 63% (116/184) and not random: 75 of 79 bets Tj placed have a Tracker close vs 41 of 105 he did not place; unplaced bets only +0.82% [-0.02%, +2.03%] on 41 closes / 24 games; unclosed bets' mean listed EV 3.65% vs closed 3.44% (no sign of closed bets being higher-EV). Oct 5 entries: 18 of 57 closed.

Concentration is modest: one game (Detroit-Carolina) holds 26 of the 116 closes (CLV +1.0%); leave-one-game-out CLV range +2.40% to +2.99%; dropping the five biggest-contributing games leaves +2.49% [+1.71%, +3.22%] on 68 closes / 35 games. By league: NFL +2.15% (75 closes/15 games), NHL +3.92% (28/14), NCAAF +1.48% (8/8); by Receiving Yards props (28 closes) only +0.54%.

CLV for R1 is at the entry look's price; the loader's rule_report(mask) uses the first-listed price (R1 bets: +1.64%), so the two are not interchangeable. The loader labels 'Tracker - Novig's trades' closes (17 bets overall) as tracker, so the 'independent' group here is pinnacle + espn + novig_trades(>=3) = 33 closes (28 + 4 + 1).

To settle it: independent-close CLV of R1 needs about 165 independent closes / ~115 games for a cluster SE of 0.25 pts (now 0.56 pts on 33 / 23 games); at ~15 independent closes a day (33 in 2.26 days) that is roughly 11 days of the same logging, with the window effect needing a held-out set fixed in advance. Say 'the data suggests' and make no change to which bets are placed from this; any change to the entry rule is a question for Tj, not an action, and nothing here argues for loosening a limit.
